LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueExplanation: Agents work quietly and unilaterally: no House agrees to be spied on. Silver is spent when the operation is launched, the outcome is fixed then, and reloading cannot change it. At most {0} operations run across the realm at once. Being caught costs honour and goodwill, and invites an answer in kind.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueSummarySpy: Reveal this House's coffers and improve negotiations temporarily.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueSummaryBribe: Pay a named court member to support your proposals.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueSummarySabotage: Damage this House's treasury and one available garrison.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueSummaryFavour: Build a useful friendship between both House Heads.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueSummaryPoison: Make a named court member nonlethally ill for several days.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueSummaryAbduct: Bring a named court member unconscious to your keep.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueRulesTooltip: Silver is spent and both rolls are fixed when launched. Discovery is separate from success and costs goodwill and House Integrity; it may provoke a hostile plot. At most {0} operations may run realm-wide and only one may target a House. A loaded keep, sufficient silver and any required eligible adult target are mandatory. Sacred Oaths and Chivalric Honor followers dislike using intrigue.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueTipSpy: Your agent reads their ledgers and quietly prepares your approach. Their exact coffers become visible and proposals involving this House gain 10 acceptance points for fifteen days. Takes {0} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueTipBribe: Bribe a lord or influential courtier to secretly support your interests. Proposals involving this House gain 15 acceptance points for twenty days. Takes {0} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueTipSabotage: Unrest in their lands drains a quarter of their coffers and weakens one of their garrisons. Takes {0} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueTipFavour: Build a personal, non-romantic friendship between your House Head and theirs. Goodwill improves immediately and proposals gain 10 acceptance points for thirty days. Takes {0} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueTipPoison: Pay someone at court to secretly poison the selected character. The resulting illness lasts several days and is not lethal on its own. Takes {0} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueTipAbduct: Attempt to abduct a selected member of their court and bring them unconscious to your keep. You will need to secure the captive on arrival; they do not join your House automatically. Takes {0} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueLaunched: {0} against {1}: your agent leaves tonight and should report in {2} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueAbandonConfirm: Recall your agent before the work is done? The silver you spent is returned and nothing is attempted. Nobody learns of it and no honour is lost.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueAbandoned: Your agent in the lands of {0} has been recalled. Nothing came of it and the silver was returned.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueFailedDetail: Your agent found no opening and withdrew. The silver is spent.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueSpyDetail: Their coffers hold about {0} silver. You will see their true figure and gain leverage in negotiations for {1} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueBribeDetail: {0} has taken your silver and will secretly support your interests for {1} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueSabotageDetail: Unrest cost them about {0} silver and the garrison of {1} is weakened.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueFavourDetail: {0} is a friend to your House. Negotiations are easier for {1} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntriguePoisonDetail: {0} has fallen ill and will be abed for several days.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueAbductDetail: {0} lies unconscious outside your keep. What happens next is up to you — and to the usual rules of captivity.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueExposed: {0}: your hand was traced. {1} knows. Your House loses {2} honour and {3} goodwill, and any friend you had at their court is finished.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueSpyActive: Your spy reveals their coffers and strengthens proposals for {0}.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueBribeActive: A bribed lord supports you for {0}.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueFavourActive: The two House Heads share a personal friendship for {0}.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntriguePlotActive: They are moving against you: {0} to answer.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueUnavailable: Only a Westerosi House can be worked against this way.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueBusyHouse: An operation against this House is already under way.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueBusyRealm: You can only run {0} operations at once.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueNoKeep: Your keep must be loaded to pay and brief an agent.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueNoSilver: Your keep needs {0} silver for this.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueNoTarget: No eligible adult at their court is free for this.
LanguageData.ARIO_IntrigueNoHead: Their current House Head is not available for this.
LanguageData.ARIO_PlotTheftBody: {0} has sent people of their own after your House. Your informants say they mean to take about {1} silver from your keep.\n\nPaying {2} silver to your informants now foils it. Doing nothing for {3} days lets it happen.
LanguageData.ARIO_PlotSabotageBody: {0} has sent people of their own after your House. Your informants say the target is {1}.\n\nPaying {2} silver to your informants now foils it. Doing nothing for {3} days lets it happen.
LanguageData.ARIO_PlotCountered: Your informants found {0}'s people first. Nothing came of their plot.
LanguageData.ARIO_PlotIgnored: You have decided to let {0}'s people try.
LanguageData.ARIO_PlotSabotageDone: {0}'s people struck at {1}. Its garrison and prosperity have suffered.
